review: 701.22d-1: replaced the open Forge question with the result of reading GameAction.scry (the trigger runs with an empty library) and noted how the empty library is reached.

scenarios.title: Scrying 0 is not a scry event and triggers nothing
decisions: A casts Graven Lore, paying with the five Snow-Covered Islands.
Both players pass; Graven Lore resolves: A scries 5 (looks at five Forests), keeps all five on top in order, then draws three cards.

variants.label: scry_five
variants.expected: A scries 5, so Flamespeaker Adept's 'whenever you scry' trigger fires: Flamespeaker Adept is 4/3 with first strike until end of turn. A draws three cards.

variants.label: scry_zero
variants.delta: A pays for Graven Lore with the five non-snow Islands, so X is 0 and A scries 0.
variants.expected: No scry event occurs and Flamespeaker Adept's trigger does not fire: it stays 2/3 without first strike. A still draws three cards.

scenarios.forge_notes: GameAction.scry returns before any event when the scry number is 0.

scenarios.title: A scry trigger fires after the scry even if the scry was impossible

setup.notes: A drew the last card of A's library earlier, so A's library is empty but A has not lost the game.

decisions: Its enters trigger goes on the stack; both players pass; it resolves and A scries 1 with an empty library.

variants.label: empty_library
variants.expected: Temple of Mystery enters tapped. A has no cards to look at, but A still scried: Flamespeaker Adept's trigger fires and it is 4/3 with first strike until end of turn.

variants.label: opponent_controls_adept
variants.delta: Flamespeaker Adept is controlled by B instead of A.
variants.expected: A scries but the trigger watches its controller's scries only: Flamespeaker Adept's trigger does not fire and it stays 2/3 without first strike.

scenarios.forge_notes: GameAction.scry keeps a player with an empty library among the scrying players and runs the Scry trigger with ScryNum 0 after the (empty) arrangement.
